actions.description: Create a new activity in Pipedrive.
actions.name: create-activity

subject.description: The subject of the activity. Example: "Discuss revenue with John"

type.description: The type of the activity. Example: "call", "meeting", "lunch". Use ActivityTypes API to get available types.

owner_id.description: The ID of the user who owns the activity. Example: 12345

deal_id.description: The ID of the deal linked to the activity. Example: 98765

lead_id.description: The ID of the lead linked to the activity. Example: "a1b2c3d4e5f6"

person_id.description: The ID of the person linked to the activity. Example: 56789

org_id.description: The ID of the organization linked to the activity. Example: 34567

project_id.description: The ID of the project linked to the activity. Example: 11122

due_date.description: The due date of the activity in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2025-05-15"

due_time.description: The due time of the activity in HH:MM format. Example: "14:30"

duration.description: The duration of the activity in HH:MM format. Example: "01:00"

busy.description: Whether the activity marks the assignee as busy or not in their calendar

done.description: Whether the activity is marked as done or not

value.description: The full address of the activity

admin_area_level_1.description: Admin area level 1 (e.g. state) of the activity

admin_area_level_2.description: Admin area level 2 (e.g. county) of the activity

subpremise.description: Subpremise (e.g. apartment/suite number) of the activity

person_id.description: The ID of the person

primary.description: Whether the person is the primary participant or not

email.description: The email address of the attendee

is_organizer.description: Whether the attendee is the organizer or not

person_id.description: The ID of the person if the attendee has a person record

user_id.description: The ID of the user if the attendee is a user

public_description.description: The public description of the activity that will be synced to external calendar

priority.description: The priority of the activity. Mappable to a specific string using activityFields API. Example: 1

id.description: The ID of the created activity

done.description: Whether the activity is marked as done

due_date.description: The due date of the activity

due_time.description: The due time of the activity

busy_flag.description: Whether the activity marks the assignee as busy

owner_id.description: The ID of the user who owns the activity

deal_id.description: The ID of the deal linked to the activity

lead_id.description: The ID of the lead linked to the activity

person_id.description: The ID of the person linked to the activity

org_id.description: The ID of the organization linked to the activity

project_id.description: The ID of the project linked to the activity

public_description.description: The public description of the activity

add_time.description: The time when the activity was created

title.description: The title of the deal. Example: "Deal of the century"

value.description: The value of the deal. Example: 10000

currency.description: The currency of the deal. Accepts a 3-character currency code. Example: "USD"

user_id.description: The ID of the user which will be the owner of the created deal. Example: 123

person_id.description: The ID of a person which this deal will be linked to. Example: 456

org_id.description: The ID of an organization which this deal will be linked to. Example: 789

pipeline_id.description: The ID of the pipeline this deal will be added to. Example: 1

stage_id.description: The ID of the stage this deal will be added to. Example: 2

status.description: The status of the deal. Values: open, won, lost

expected_close_date.description: The expected close date of the deal. In ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: "2025-12-31"

probability.description: The success probability percentage of the deal. Example: 60

visible_to.description: The visibility of the deal. 1 = Owner only, 3 = Owner and followers, 5 = Entire company

lost_reason.description: The reason for losing the deal. Only used when status is lost

add_time.description: The optional creation date and time of the deal in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

id.description: The ID of the created deal

user_id.description: The ID of the deal owner

person_id.description: The ID of the linked person

org_id.description: The ID of the linked organization

lost_reason.description: The reason for losing the deal

add_time.description: The creation time of the deal

update_time.description: The last update time of the deal

person_id.description: The ID of a person to link the lead to. Required unless organization_id is specified.

organization_id.description: The ID of an organization to link the lead to. Required unless person_id is specified.

owner_id.description: The ID of the user who will own the lead

label_ids.description: The IDs of lead labels to associate with the lead

value.description: The potential value of the lead

expected_close_date.description: The expected close date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

was_seen.description: Whether the lead was seen in the Pipedrive UI

origin_id.description: Optional ID to distinguish the origin of the lead

channel.description: The ID of the marketing channel

channel_id.description: Optional ID to further distinguish the marketing channel

content.description: The content of the note in HTML format. Subject to sanitization on the back-end.

deal_id.description: The ID of the deal the note will be attached to.

person_id.description: The ID of the person the note will be attached to.

org_id.description: The ID of the organization the note will be attached to.

lead_id.description: The ID of the lead the note will be attached to.

project_id.description: The ID of the project the note will be attached to.

task_id.description: The ID of the task the note will be attached to.

user_id.description: The ID of the user who will be marked as the author of the note. Only an admin can change the author.

add_time.description: The optional creation date & time of the note in UTC. Can be set in the past or in the future. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

pinned_to_lead_flag.description: If set to 1, the note will be pinned to the lead.

pinned_to_project_flag.description: If set to 1, the note will be pinned to the project.

name.description: The name of the organization. Example: "Acme Corp"

owner_id.description: The ID of the user who owns the organization. Example: 12345

visible_to.description: The visibility of the organization. 1 = owner and followers, 2 = entire company, 3 = owner only.

label_ids.description: The IDs of labels assigned to the organization.

value.description: The full address of the organization.

admin_area_level_1.description: Admin area level 1 (e.g. state) of the organization.

admin_area_level_2.description: Admin area level 2 (e.g. county) of the organization.

subpremise.description: Subpremise (e.g. apartment/suite number) of the organization.

owner_id.description: The ID of the user who owns the person

org_id.description: The ID of the organization linked to the person

marketing_status.description: The marketing status of the person

name.description: The name of the pipeline. Example: "Sales Pipeline"

deal_probability.description: Whether deal probability is enabled for this pipeline

name.description: The name of the product. Cannot be an empty string.

unit.description: The unit in which this product is sold.

owner_id.description: The ID of the user who will be marked as the owner of this product.

is_linkable.description: Whether this product can be added to a deal or not.

billing_frequency.description: How often a customer is billed.

billing_frequency_cycles.description: The number of times the billing frequency repeats.

name.description: The name of the stage. Example: "Qualified Lead"

pipeline_id.description: The ID of the pipeline to add the stage to. Example: 1

deal_probability.description: The success probability percentage of the deal. Used/shown when deal weighted values are used. Example: 50

is_deal_rot_enabled.description: Whether deals in this stage can become rotten

days_to_rotten.description: The number of days the deals not updated in this stage would become rotten. Applies only if is_deal_rot_enabled is set.
